name: Greatsword: Prologue
detailed_description:
This is a challenge of iron and blood, and rare Greatswords of various shapes are about to arrive at your side. Choose your sword of destiny, split the darkness, and resolve the crisis. Destroy enemies, get rewards, and rush to the next battlefield!

A large number of Greatswords to choose from

"Greatsword : Prologue" provides 30+ giant swords for you to choose from. You can hold the Greatsword tightly, wash away the shame, and continue the legend; you can also control the Blade of Judgment and cut off the darkness.

A large number of special skills

Whirlwind Slash, Sky Breaking Stab, Earth Breaking Strike, Thunder Sword Formation, etc., here are 30+ various sword skills to help you kill the enemy.

A large number of meat pigeon props

100+ diversified props, various props such as body forging, magic repair, etc. for you to choose.

Diverse enemies and maps

There are a variety of enemies and challenging maps for you to experience.
